related_post.title: 111- pars php code extract function name
related_post.ori_question:
I have to make a script in PHP that will scan other PHP files to check for dangerous function calls like eval,exec . Is there any parser available that can give me a logical structure of code.

Or i have to go with Regex.

Thanks, any type suggestions are welcome.

Arshdeep

Edit: i am not considering it as "one shot kill all". I have some other things in mind too, but its still something that i have to do.
related_post.accepted_answers:
111 - You can use tokenizer to do that:

print_r(token_get_all('<?php exec("rm -rf *"); ?>'));
Notice in the output the third element which is:

[1] => Array
    (
        [0] => 307
        [1] => exec
        [2] => 1
    )
related_post.similarity: Exact Match – The user's question fully aligns with the given technique.

- Implement a node visitor to traverse the abstract syntax tree (AST) generated by PHP-Parser and disable or modify suspicious function calls.
- Consider modifying the PHP configuration (e.g., setting `disable_functions` or `disable_classes`) to prevent execution of specific functions.
- Use the intercepted function call data to create a comprehensive list of potential vulnerabilities and provide recommendations for mitigation.
